title: SMOK RGC Replacement Coils
description:
Description
Note: Sold individually. Please adjust the quantity to the desired number prior to ordering.
SMOK RGC Replacement Coils comes in Meshed 0.17ohm and is installed in a press-fit manner. It is specially made for the RPM80/ RPM80 Pro mod kit and perfectly matched with the RGC Pod.
Best at 40-80W.
